Diagnose a subsampling custom-Stan gradient and envelope

Source: R/stan_subsampling.R
stan_subsampling_diagnostics.Rd

Evaluates the persistent full, prior-only, and selected Stan modes at one position without starting a sampler. The selected likelihood gradient is unscaled; `selected_scale` reports the `N / m` factor applied by Julia when forming the subsampling gradient. The residual event-rate diagnostic uses the same typed envelope and trajectory geometry as sampling.

Usage

stan_subsampling_diagnostics(
  path_to_stanmodel,
  standata,
  subsampling,
  position,
  subset,
  velocity = NULL,
  flow = c("ZigZag", "BouncyParticle", "AdaptiveBoomerang"),
  flow_mean = NULL,
  flow_cov = NULL,
  phase = c("main", "warmup")
)

Arguments

path_to_stanmodel

Stan source or compiled-library path containing the package subset hook.

standata

Full-likelihood Stan data list or JSON path.

subsampling

A specification from [stan_subsampling()].

position

Finite unconstrained parameter vector.

subset

One-based observation indices, with exactly the configured subsample size and no duplicates.

velocity

Finite diagnostic velocity. Defaults to a vector of ones.

flow

Supported subsampling flow used for the rate diagnostic.

flow_mean

Optional flow mean.

flow_cov

Optional flow covariance.

phase

Diagnostic sampling phase. For staged HCV specifications, `"main"` activates HCV and `"warmup"` uses the first-order fallback.

Value

A list of gradient-closure, residual-rate, envelope, and construction diagnostics.
